description: Chess puzzle database. All puzzles are intended as White to move and mate in 1. Task order follows source diagrams left to right, then top to bottom. Incorrect attempts may be retried; the next puzzle unlocks after a correct solution. Validation status distinguishes user-provided solutions from independent engine verification.
